svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"rank-senior-colonel-bullion","units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,133.89,67.94],"name":"Colonel bullion grade insignia, mess dress shoulder board","size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same shape and size as the embroidered form rank-senior-colonel-thread (1.3389 x 0.6794 in): CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-3 says only that the grade on the boards is metal bullion and gives no size. Male boards 5 1/2 x 2 1/4 in, female 4 1/2 x 2 in.","provenance":"recoloured from rank-senior-colonel-thread: bullion silver (2d Lt and Major gold, others silver, matching the metal and thread forms); bullion texture drawn as a diagonal line pattern","colours":{"bullion":"#c6cbd1","bullion_line":"#8f969e","bullion_edge":"#7d848c"},"anchors":{"top_center":[66.95,0],"bottom_center":[66.95,67.94],"center":[66.95,33.97],"left_edge":[0,33.97],"right_edge":[133.89,33.97],"insignia_center":[66.95,33.97],"rank_slot_center":[66.95,33.97],"mount_center":[66.95,33.97]},"dimensions":{"form":"metal bullion grade insignia (mess dress shoulder board)","insignia_w_in":1.3389,"insignia_h_in":0.6794,"shape":"eagle, wings spread, head to the wearer's right (beak forward)","thread":"silver bullion","orientation":"beak points toward the wearer's right shoulder = the viewer's LEFT on a front view (regulation text: CAPR 39-1 6.1.14.4.1 and the OCP/ABU grade rules, DAFI 36-2903 7.1.3.1.1, 4.5.1.1.3). The figures (A5-1/A5-2) draw the beak toward the viewer's right; the traced art is MIRRORED to follow the text (Ethan, 2026-10-13)","slot_fit":{"garment_rank_slot_in":{"along":1.5,"across":1.2},"piece_along_in":1.339,"piece_across_in":0.679,"scale_to_garment_slot":1,"note":"placement rule: leaf stem / stacked stars along the board, bars across, Colonel eagle wingspan along the board; scale < 1 only if the piece must stay inside the slot"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Men's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-male-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 5.5 x 2.25 in, 1/2 in dark blue lace each side (general officer boards: silver lace with 1/2 in blue lace), button at the peak (4.1.1.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."},{"uniform":"Women's mess dress shoulder boards (garment-mess-dress-female-officer-shoulder-boards)","rule":"centred on the board with the board centre line, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; board 4.5 x 2 in, 1/4 in blue lace each side on every grade (Fig A5-3), no button (4.1.2.1.1.1, Fig A5-3). Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar, Colonel eagle beak forward (4.1.1.1.1.2-3). No distance from the board end is given by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; use the garment rank_slot centre."}],"rank":{"grade":"Colonel","abbrev":"Col","membership":"senior"},"grade":"rank-insignia","size_in":{"w":1.3389,"h":0.6794}}
